description: CGV-1 PIN gate + caregiver layout/nav shell, plus shared TrustBadge component, AND CGV-6 Dashboard (real backend). This is the foundation every other caregiver screen navigates through, so it comes first. The caregiver GROUP entry becomes a PIN gate in app/(caregiver)/_layout.tsx; once a caregiver id exists it renders the nav shell over the 7 screens. Dashboard is bundled here because it is the group's landing screen, uses the real GET /dashboard, and its item rows must deep-link into the fixing screens built in later FEATs (links can be wired to the existing route names, which already resolve as placeholders). Depends on nothing earlier; independent FEATs 002-005 build on the gate this establishes.
steps: Read /Users/lex/Hackathon_App_Builders/echovault/.worktrees/caregiver-app/mobile/.agents/tasks/task-caregiver-app/context.json and this FEAT file FIRST — context.json replaces re-exploration.

Add src/components/TrustBadge.tsx: a themed colored pill taking { trust: Trust; theme? } mapping verified->colors.success, unverified->colors.muted, conflicting->colors.danger, outdated->colors.border/muted. Reuse theme tokens.

Optionally add src/components/Field.tsx (labelled themed TextInput) and src/components/OptionRow.tsx (segmented single/multi select over a string union) if they reduce duplication across later screens; keep them generic and theme-driven. Skip if not needed.

Rework app/(caregiver)/_layout.tsx into the PIN gate + nav shell: on mount read getCaregiverId(); if null render a PIN entry screen (TextInput secureTextEntry, numeric), on submit call pinLogin(pin) from src/api/auth; on success call setCaregiverId(result.id) and reveal the group (role is already 'caregiver' from app/index.tsx, do not re-set it). Wrong PIN / any `instanceof ApiError` shows an inline error (err.message) and stays on PIN. Render a Stack (headerShown:false) over the 7 screens once unlocked, with navigation between them (a BigButton hub on dashboard or a simple header nav). Provide a visible 'Leave caregiver mode' action that calls setCaregiverId(null) then router.replace('/'). Keep existing route/file names.

Rebuild app/(caregiver)/dashboard.tsx as the REAL dashboard: call getDashboard() from src/api/dashboard. Render sectioned lists + counts for unverified_memories, conflicting_pairs, outdated_memories, medication_attention (MedicationLogWithMed), flagged_answers (AssistantLog). Each row is tappable and navigates via useRouter().push to the fixing screen: memory rows -> /(caregiver)/memories, medication rows -> /(caregiver)/medications. Render activity_summary rows using played_count / skipped_count / topic ONLY — NEVER a score, rating, percentage, accuracy, or cognitive measure (hard product constraint from docs/PRODUCT.md). Add a short visible note that activity is engagement, not a clinical assessment.
Implement loading (ActivityIndicator), error (catch `instanceof ApiError`, show err.message + a retry BigButton), and empty states on the dashboard and the PIN gate.

Add inline code comments noting auth is a stubbed backend module (POST /auth/pin returns 404 until AUTH-2 lands) so a 404 ApiError on the PIN screen renders the error state cleanly rather than crashing.
acceptance_criteria: A submitted PIN calls pinLogin and on success persists the caregiver id via setCaregiverId; a wrong PIN or any ApiError shows an inline error and stays on the PIN screen.
Leaving caregiver mode calls setCaregiverId(null) and returns to the mode picker, so the PIN is required again.
The caregiver nav shell lets the user reach all 7 screens (dashboard, memories, people, schedule, medications, activities, backup) by their existing route names.

Dashboard calls getDashboard() and renders counts+lists for unverified memories, conflicting pairs, outdated memories, medication attention, and flagged answers, each row linking to its fixing screen.
The dashboard activity summary shows played/skipped counts and topic with NO score/rating/percentage anywhere.
From mobile/: npx tsc --noEmit prints zero errors and grep -rn 'fetch(' app returns nothing.
findings:
DELIVERED: src/components/TrustBadge.tsx; app/(caregiver)/_layout.tsx (PIN gate + nav shell + leave-mode context); app/(caregiver)/dashboard.tsx (real GET /dashboard). Build gate GREEN: npm install exit 0, npx tsc --noEmit zero errors, grep -rn 'fetch(' app returns nothing.

TrustBadge: `import TrustBadge from "../../src/components/TrustBadge"` (from app/(caregiver)/*; adjust ../ depth for nested routes e.g. memories/[id].tsx uses `../../../src/components/TrustBadge`). Props: { trust: Trust; theme?: Theme }. Default-exported. Renders a self-aligned pill (alignSelf:'flex-start'). Colour map: verified->colors.success, unverified->colors.muted, conflicting->colors.danger, outdated->colors.border (dark text on outdated, white text otherwise). Labels: Verified/Unverified/Conflicting/Outdated. Reuse it on memory and people rows in later FEATs.

NAV SHELL CONTRACT (app/(caregiver)/_layout.tsx): the layout IS the PIN gate. Phases checking->locked->unlocked. On mount reads getCaregiverId(); null => locked PIN screen (TextInput secureTextEntry + number-pad). Submit calls pinLogin(pin) from src/api/auth, on success setCaregiverId(result.id) and unlock. Role is NOT re-set (app/index.tsx already set it). Any `instanceof ApiError` renders err.message inline and stays locked (auth is a 404 stub today). Once unlocked it renders a Stack(headerShown:false) with Stack.Screen names: dashboard, memories/index, people, schedule, medications, activities, backup. Later FEATs that add routes (e.g. memories/[id]) should add a matching <Stack.Screen name="memories/[id]"/> here. The layout exports a hook `useCaregiverGate()` returning { leaveCaregiverMode(): Promise<void> } (import: `import { useCaregiverGate } from "./_layout"` from sibling screens). leaveCaregiverMode() calls setCaregiverId(null), re-locks, and router.replace('/'). Any caregiver screen can call it for a visible exit.

DASHBOARD DEEP-LINKS (app/(caregiver)/dashboard.tsx): calls getDashboard(). Sections with count pills: unverified_memories, conflicting_pairs, outdated_memories (rows -> router.push('/(caregiver)/memories')), medication_attention (rows -> router.push('/(caregiver)/medications')), flagged_answers (rows -> router.push('/(caregiver)/memories')). When memories/[id].tsx exists in a later FEAT, re-point memory/flagged rows to router.push({ pathname:'/(caregiver)/memories/[id]', params:{ id } }). activity_summary rows show activity + topic + 'Played N · Skipped N' ONLY — no score/rating/percentage, plus a visible 'engagement, not a clinical assessment' note (hard product constraint). Three async states implemented: loading (ActivityIndicator), error (catch instanceof ApiError -> err.message + 'Try again' BigButton), empty (per-section empty notes + top-level 'nothing needs attention'). Manage hub = BigButtons to all 7 screens; also a 'Leave caregiver mode' danger BigButton wired to useCaregiverGate().

NOTE for later FEATs: screens import src with relative paths (../../src/...), consistent with existing app/ files; @/* alias is unused in app/. Reuse BigButton/PersonCard/TrustBadge; follow useTheme()+SafeAreaView+loading/error/empty pattern.
